newsitem.title: USA: Office Depot, Staples delay shareholder meetings.
newsitem.headline: Office Depot, Staples delay shareholder meetings.

text.p: Staples Inc. and Office Depot Inc. said Thursday they plan to postpone their special shareholder meetings, scheduled for Friday, until March 14, because of a delay in regulators' response to their merger plans.
Last week the companies extended until March 13 the date by which they expect a response from the Federal Trade Commission.
"As such response has not yet been received the companies plan to adjourn the meetings tomorrow," they said in a statement.
The companies signed a definitive agreement last September to merge in a $3.6 billion deal, pending regulatory and shareholder approval.
Staples, Inc. operates 577 office products superstores in over 100 markets across the United States and in Canada.
Office Depot operates 572 stores in North America.
Westborough, Mass.-based Staples' stock was unchanged at $24.375 on Nasdaq. Office Depot rose 50 cents to $22.75 on the New York Stock Exchange.
